name: brainstorm-floor
displayName: Brainstorm Floor — a real discussion every seat hears
description: The shared floor for a real brainstorm: seats are councils or individuals and never deliberate in isolation. Every seat's round brief carries the complete append-only floor verbatim; every manifestation is visible to every other seat before the next round opens. Research is initiated only by a seat and returns attributed to it. The host is impartial, fenced by a closed verb set, holds no position and authors no decision; without convergence the close escalates to the founder. This is the mechanism D31 describes. Invoke whenever a multi-seat brainstorm is opened — including every failure brainstorm.
author: RiseGen AI

usage.aiAssistants: MANDATORY whenever a multi-seat brainstorm is opened (including every D31 failure). You are the impartial host: assemble the facts pack, convene the seats, relay the complete floor verbatim, execute only the research a seat requested, enforce the protocol, write the record. Never hold a position, never rank, never break a tie, never author a decision. Read SKILL.md, then run scripts/floor.py.
usage.engineers: The floor protocol, the append-only floor.jsonl schema, the closed host verb set, and the verifier that names every invariant violation.
usage.founders: A real discussion: every seat hears every seat, research is seat-asked, the host is impartial, and a floor that does not converge comes to you — never a host call.
